comment: What the probe trace of GOG's Japanese Biohazard.exe showed behaving as described (tools/Lockpick.Probe trace, 15 min, owner playing Chris from the title: main hall, 1F west, 2F and back; pickups, a first aid spray, zombie and dog fights). Applied by tools/re1/port_profile.py --live. Fields not listed stay static.
session: Chris new game, owner, probe trace

fields.stage: 0 on 1F, 1 after the stairs to 2F, 0 again back down.
fields.room: 0x1B for the intro, then 06 (main hall) and the rooms the owner walked through (05, 04, 07, 08 …), changing at each door.
fields.camera: 157 changes, at the camera cuts while walking.
fields.hp: 140 at the start; 130/120/110/100 in steps of 10 from zombie bites; back to 140 with the first aid spray; down to 46 later.
fields.maxHp: 140 (Chris) from the start of the game.
fields.gameTimer: 0 at New Game, 21 984 frames (12.2 min at 30/s) after 13.4 min of play: it stands still in door transitions (B206).
fields.mainMenu: 1 on the title menu, 0 once the game started.
fields.positionX: Changes as the player walks (trace context).
fields.positionZ: Changes as the player walks (trace context).
fields.inventoryPtr: Holds 0xC38814 (the inventory) from the start of Chris's game.
fields.inv1: First aid spray (0x41 x1) at the start, the Emblem after the spray was used (HP back to 140 at the same moment), later the Beretta counting down.
fields.inv2: Items as picked up (Emblem, Beretta 15 counting down per shot, Clip, Shells).
fields.inv3: Beretta 15 → 14 → 13 … per shot, the Sword key, Shells.
fields.inv1Qty: 1 for the spray; the Beretta's rounds per shot.
fields.equippedSlot: 4, 3, 2 as the Beretta moved between slots.
fields.enemy0Hp: A zombie's HP fell by 9 at the moments the Beretta's rounds dropped; −1 when it died.
fields.enemy0Type: 0 (zombie), 2 (dog), 0x11, and NPC types 0x23/0x24/0x26 in the cutscene rooms.
fields.flagRoomItems0: Bits cleared at the moments items appeared in the inventory.
fields.flagRoomItems1: Bits cleared at the moments items appeared in the inventory.
fields.box0: 0x0F0B (Clip x15) at the start, then the item stored.

windowFocused.session: lab: GOG Japanese Biohazard.exe on this PC, a virtual Xbox pad, community saves loaded into new Japanese slots
windowFocused.seen: 0 while the game ran unfocused (the picture stood still, the in-game clock 0x47 then frozen) and 1 as soon as its window was brought to the front (the title answered the pad, the clock ran on); 0 again when another window was clicked (the game paused, as the owner saw), 1 when it came back.
